text: Ɓen jaŋtaaɓe e nder ndee simoore, joŋi e Jakariyaa joofi e Idriisa (yo ɓe his), ko ɓen woni ɓen, ɓe Alla Neeminiri e mu'un Annabaaku ka ɓiɗɓe Aadama (yo o his), e ɓiɗɓe ɓen ɓe Me njol-nunoka laana e bibbe Ibhiima e ɓiɗɓe Yaaquuba (yo ɓe his), e ɓen ɓe Men hawrinndiniri peewal faade e Lislaamu, Men Suɓi ɓe Men waɗi ɓe Annabaaɓe, ɓe laatinoke si ɓe nanii Aayeeje Alla ɗen no janngee ɓe sujjanay Alla ko ɓe wullooɓe sabu kulol Makko.
